# Trading policy

Standing rules. These are true across every account and every quote, which is why
they live here rather than on any one page.

**What the bakery will not take on**

- Standing orders under 40 loaves per week.
- Anything outside the 6 km delivery radius, and any second same-day drop.
- Own-label or unbranded supply, and sale-or-return of any kind.
- Exclusivity in an area, on any terms.

**Quoting**

- Only the owner quotes. Nobody else gives a price, a discount or a date, in
  writing or otherwise.
- Quotes are given from the current rate card only, and always with the date the
  prices are current as of. A price without its date is not a quote.
- The one volume tier on [pricing](../wiki/pricing.md) is the whole discount
  policy. Nothing is discounted below it, including for volume, loyalty or trial.

**Claims in anything a customer reads**

- The bread is described by what it is — flour, time, shape. No health claims,
  no organic claim (the flour is not certified), no origin claim beyond the mill
  being named.
- Lead times and delivery windows are stated as they are in
  [the wholesale bread programme](../wiki/wholesale-bread-programme.md), never
  improved to win an account.

**Confidentiality**

- Account terms, volumes and names are not shared between accounts, are not used
  as examples in outward-facing material, and are not aggregated into a claim
  about what "most customers" pay.
